name: USW-Pro-XG-24
title: Switch Pro XG 24
summary: 1U L3 Etherlighting switch: 16x 10GbE + 8x 2.5GbE RJ45 and 2x 25G SFP28 uplinks, no PoE.

requires: UniFi OS console / gateway running UniFi Network (9.0.114+)
SFP28/SFP+ optics or DAC for uplinks

gotchas: No PoE — for powering WiFi 7 APs on 10G ports, the PoE sibling (USW-Pro-XG-24-PoE) is the one to buy.
Only 2x 25G uplinks behind 16x 10G + 8x 2.5G (180G of access) — ~3.6:1 oversubscribed to the core.
No dedicated SFP+ cages: 10G fiber only via the two SFP28 ports (which also serve as uplinks).
10/100M half-duplex unsupported — very old devices may not link.
Deep 1U chassis (480 mm) needs 4-post rack; DC backup only via USP-RPS.
